messages:
anya: Heads-up: cobalt-slim-q5 canary showing BLEU -4.2 on zh->ja testset after a pinyin-normalization change. Repro locally with the canary build.

yuki: :eyes: got a short repro? sample inputs/outputs?

anya: Minimal repro below — source is zh with pinyin-inserted spacing, model emits kana-glue and missing honorifics.

anya: ```
SRC: 北京你好 -> "北京  ni hao"
TOKENIZER_BEFORE: ["北京", "你好"]
TOKENIZER_AFTER:  ["北", "京", " ", "ni", "hao"]
MODEL_OUT_CANARY: "北京にこんにちは"  <-- fused kana no spacing
MODEL_OUT_BASE: "北京 に こんにちは" 
```

miguel: Hmm. That tokenizer split into latin pinyin tokens with an explicit ascii space token in the middle — can break KV cache because prefix bytes differ. I see kvcache miss rate spike in canary.

miguel: ```
kvcache.hit_rate.base=0.87
kvcache.hit_rate.canary=0.12
log: kv_key=sha1(prefix+b" ") vs sha1(prefix)
```

jordan: Is this from the new normalizer that inserts ascii spaces for pinyin expansions? Patch landed in tokenizer v1.4.2 (commit 7a9f2c).

anya: Exactly. Bisect points to 7a9f2c -> 3f2be11 as the suspect range. Also affects ja->zh pairings (kana alignment) — quality drop larger for mixed-script dialogs.

yuki: Quick hypothesis: normalizer now emits U+0020 between CJK and ascii segments, upstream detokenizer expects ZWSP (U+200B) or no space. Beam scoring sees different prefixes and top-k paths change.

miguel: Repro script attached, ran with quant q5 build. Might be amplified by quant rounding — small token shifts yield different topk and hydration of kana tokens.

triage-bot: Created issue RED-ML-1229 and assigned eng-ml. CI canary label added.

anya: Next steps: 1) rollback tokenizer normalizer in canary and re-run smoke; 2) add token-level alignment tests for mixed CJK+latin; 3) bisect quant pruning effects. I'll open a short PR for temporary revert.

yuki: I can add a focused eval set (pinyin+hangul+kana) and run per-model sanity across int4/q5/q8 to measure amplification.

miguel: FYI I pushed a small monitor that compares kvcache.signature before/after so we can watch live; will slack alerts on >5% delta.

anya: Thanks — I'll post results shortly. :thumbsup:
